name: progresful-construction
description: Constructor: answers questions about construction drawings, with the evidence marked on the plan

scripts.backend: export VERDA_INFERENCE_KEY="${VERDA_INFERENCE_KEY:-$(sed -n 's/^key: //p' .instructions 2>/dev/null)}" GEMINI_API_KEY="${GEMINI_API_KEY:-$(sed -n 's/^gemini key: //p' .instructions 2>/dev/null)}" CONSTRUCTOR_DATA="${CONSTRUCTOR_DATA:-data/full/junction-dataset}" && uv run --extra extract --extra app uvicorn constructor.server:app --port 8000 --reload --reload-dir constructor --timeout-graceful-shutdown 3
scripts.dev: npm run backend & npm run frontend
scripts.test: uv run --extra extract pytest -q && npm --prefix app run typecheck && npm --prefix app test
